workgroup.description: The NetBIOS workgroup or domain name (typically uppercase).

realm.description: The DNS realm (uppercase FQDN of the Active Directory domain).

netbios_name.description: NetBIOS name of this server; must be unique within the domain and ≤15 chars.

dns_forwarder.description: IP address of the DNS forwarder for external name resolution (e.g., upstream ISP DNS or public resolver).

log_file.description: Log file path. %m expands to the machine name connecting.

log_level.description: Global log verbosity level: 0 (none) to 10 (full debug).

idmap_lines.description: List of ID mapping backend configuration lines (e.g., 'idmap config * : backend = tdb').

nss_lines.description: List of nsswitch config lines (e.g., 'winbind nss info = rfc2307').

winbind_lines.description: List of Winbind config lines (e.g., 'winbind enum users = yes').

netlogon_path.description: Path to the Netlogon share directory.

netlogon_read_only.description: Whether the Netlogon share is read-only (typically yes for security).

netlogon_writable.description: Whether the Netlogon share is writable (should be no).

netlogon_guest_ok.description: Whether guests may access the Netlogon share (should be no).

sysvol_path.description: Path to the SYSVOL shared directory (contains Group Policy, logon scripts, etc.).

sysvol_read_only.description: Whether SYSVOL share is read-only (recommended for DCs).

sysvol_writable.description: Whether SYSVOL share is writable (must be no on DCs).

sysvol_nt_acl_support.description: Enable NT ACL support in SYSVOL.

sysvol_inherit_acl.description: Whether ACLs inherit from parent directory in SYSVOL.

shares.description: List of additional Samba shares to define beyond netlogon and sysvol.

browseable.description: Whether the share appears in network browsing.

writable.description: Whether users may write to the share.

valid_users.description: List of users or groups (e.g., 'DOMAIN\user', '@domain admins') allowed access.

force_create_mode.description: Octal mode to force on new files (e.g., '0644').

force_directory_mode.description: Octal mode to force on new directories (e.g., '0755').
